# Functions!

Start small with Z Scores :
```{r}
# Make random vector:
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

# Z-score manually:
(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```
Make this a function:
```{r}
## Write the z-score as a function:
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (!is.numeric(x)) {
    stop("Input x must be numeric")
  }else if (length(x) < 5){
    stop("x should have 5 or more numbers...")
  }
  
  x_z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  return(x_z)
}

## Check if it works: 
z_scores(x_vec) ### WOOHOOO!!
z_scores(rpois(4000, lambda = 12))
```

```{r}
poisson_df = data.frame(poisson = rpois(40000, lambda = 2),
           poisson_z = z_scores(rpois(40000, lambda = 2)))


ggplot(poisson_df, aes(x = poisson)) +
  geom_histogram()
```
